text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... If your nose is itchy, could you
tell me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I always receive tissues in the raffles
around town,
so I have... a lot of them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So don't worry about taking too many,
okay?
